background_notes.justification: HasDerivAt g c tau means g(tau+h)=g(tau)+hc+o(|h|). This is the Fréchet expansion with continuous linear map h↦hc on ℝ; its value at 1 is c. A constant has zero increments and therefore the zero derivative. Applying the supplied M009 equality and evaluating at 1 consequently gives c=0.
